notes: Manufacturer spec page (Kramer Specifications tab) confirms: 1 HDMI input; 2 identical SD/HD/3G HD-SDI outputs on BNC connectors (multi-standard SMPTE 259M/292M/424M, max data rate 3Gbps — graded sdi-3g as the top-end capability the device negotiates to, per its "Max. Data Rate — 3Gbps" headline spec); powered by an external 5V DC / 470mA supply via a DC barrel jack labeled "5V DC" on the rear panel (confirmed from product photo). No HDMI version number is published, so grade omitted on the HDMI port. Desktop DigiTOOLS-form-factor unit (12.00 x 7.15 x 2.44 cm) — not rack-mountable on its own (an optional RK-3T 19" rack adapter tray exists as an accessory, but the unit itself has no rack ears), so rackUnits omitted. A medical-certified variant, FC-113-MD (IEC 60601-1-2), shares identical I/O. Rear-panel labels read "HDMI IN", "Out 1" / "Out 2" under the SD/HD-SDI group, and "5V DC" (confirmed via product image on the Kramer site); front-edge LEDs (SD/HD, OUT, ON) are indicators, not ports.
